FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 580
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Troy Stubbs
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 580 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the various
public institutions of higher education to adopt policies regarding faculty senates, faculty tenure,
and curriculum pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This bill would not otherwise affect state
or local funding.
